1.title: Machine Learning Engineering Is the Ultimate RL Task | Jennifer Zhao
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Jennifer Zhao (Preference Model, $16M seed) on using RL environments to train models for ML engineering tasks, reward hacking prevention, and recursive self-improvement bottlenecks in AI research.

1.author: MTS
1.hook: Applied research lead at Elise AI breaks down managing real-time voice latency for 5M monthly calls, fine-tuning open-source models vs LLMs, and why LLMs fail at deterministic tasks like renewal risk prediction in housing and healthcare automation.

1.title: Why Small Businesses Use AI to Hire Faster | Nich Tremper
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Gusto data on small businesses adopting AI: 7% faster headcount expansion vs peers, strongest in sub-10-employee firms; hiring concentrated in non-tech sectors (community services, healthcare, trade contracting) rather than displacement.
